title: For instances in availability zone “flare3” that also have system metadata
question: For instances in availability zone “flare3” that also have system metadata entries, list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory in MB, cached network_info JSON, the average memory_mb over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows (partitioned by VM state and ordered by memory_mb), plus the instance key name, metadata entry count, and total vCPUs summed across those metadata rows. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible_instances AS (
  SELECT i.uuid
  FROM instances i
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM instance_system_metadata sm
      WHERE sm.instance_uuid = i.uuid
    )
),
base AS (
  SELECT i.uuid,
         i.display_name,
         i.vm_state,
         i.memory_mb,
         i.key_name,
         c.network_info
  FROM instances i
  LEFT JOIN instance_info_caches c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM eligible_instances)
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT b.uuid,
         b.display_name,
         b.vm_state,
         b.memory_mb,
         b.key_name,
         b.network_info,
         AVG(b.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY b.vm_state ORDER BY b.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_memory_mb
  FROM base b
),
metadata_agg AS (
  SELECT sm.instance_uuid,
         COUNT(*) AS metadata_entry_count,
         SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus
  FROM instance_system_metadata sm
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = sm.instance_uuid
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
  GROUP BY sm.instance_uuid
)
SELECT w.uuid,
       w.display_name,
       w.vm_state,
       w.memory_mb,
       w.network_info,
       w.avg_memory_mb,
       w.key_name,
       ma.metadata_entry_count,
       ma.total_vcpus
FROM windowed w
JOIN metadata_agg ma ON ma.instance_uuid = w.uuid;
